test_framework: None configured yet for backend (no src/test directory exists) or FE (no test runner in package.json). build_command: Backend: `./gradlew build -x test` run with cwd=/Users/fepest/Projects/runNshop/api/runNshop-api (there is no test task registered, but keep -x test to be safe and fast). FE: `npm run build` run with cwd=/Users/fepest/Projects/runNshop/apps/runNshop-{admin|partner|mobile}.

verification_instructions: 1) Backend: cd api/runNshop-api && ./gradlew build -x test must succeed. 2) Start server (./gradlew bootRun, port 8080) and curl GET /api/admin/v1/orders with different keyword/status/from/to/page/size and confirm orders[]/pagination/summary change accordingly (not the same fixed JSON every time); curl GET /api/admin/v1/orders/{orderId}; curl GET /api/partner/v1/orders and /{orderId}; curl GET /api/v1/members/me/orders/{orderId}. Stop the server afterward. 3) FE: cd apps/runNshop-{app} && npm run build must succeed for admin, partner, mobile.

contribution_requirements: coding-standards.md: all data via backend API, no FE hardcoding; POST/PUT/DELETE must actually call the API (mock success response); validation implemented like production; navigation must work; admin/partner use plain CSS classes (globals.css) + NavBar/TabBar/TabContent (MDI); mobile uses Tailwind + Header/Content/BottomNav (App Router). mock-data-rules.md: mock files at api/runNshop-api/src/main/resources/mock/{v1|admin|partner}/{domain}__{METHOD}_{path}.json, response shape {code,data}. api-design-rules.md: path prefixes /api/v1, /api/admin/v1, /api/partner/v1; app-specific logic = separate Controller. work-scope.md: Order domain only, DL/정책서 as primary evidence, do not back-reference EARS/비공식자료.
key_patterns: Controller pattern (existing, e.g. AdminOrderController.kt, CustomerOrderController.kt): @RestController + @RequestMapping, constructor-injected MockLoader, @GetMapping handlers return ResponseEntity.ok(mockLoader.load(channel, filename)). THIS TASK CHANGES THAT: per DP-클래스설계/order.md (1차 근거, authoritative), a single `com.runnshop.order.service.OrderService` class (constructor-injected MockLoader for this prototype) owns ALL filtering/paging/summary logic via methods getMyOrders(memberId,page,size,status), getAdminOrders(filter: AdminOrderFilter), getPartnerOrders(vendorId, filter: PartnerOrderFilter), plus analogous detail methods getMyOrderDetail/getAdminOrderDetail/getPartnerOrderDetail (names not in DP doc for detail; chosen consistently). Controllers inject OrderService and ONLY call it + return the result — no filtering logic in Controllers. Do NOT create AdminOrderService/PartnerOrderService (an earlier draft note suggested that; superseded by the DP-grounded single-OrderService design — this is the one to implement). MockLoader.load(channel, filename): Map<String,Any> is unchanged and reused by OrderService. FE api() wrapper pattern: lib/api.ts in each app exports `api<T>(path): Promise<T>` doing fetch(`${API_BASE}${PREFIX}${path}`) and throwing on non-SUCCESS code — reuse as-is, call with query strings built via URLSearchParams. Admin/partner list screens follow FilterBar→SummaryBar→Toolbar→Table→Pagination composition (see OrderHistory.tsx); detail screens use InnerTabs (admin) or DetailShell+InnerTabs (partner, via useDetailOpener hook for modal/tab mode). Mobile detail pages follow the async Server Component pattern in app/my/claims/[claimId]/page.tsx: `params: Promise<{id}>` await, `api<T>()` in try/catch, Header+BottomNav wrapping, alert() for out-of-scope actions.
